
# PRD: Browser Reading List

## Problem Statement

Users often discover interesting articles but do not have
time to read them immediately. We want to make it easier
for users to save and revisit articles.

## Target Users

All browser users.

## Proposed Solution

Introduce a Reading List feature that lets users save
webpages and access them later.

## Functional Requirements

1. Users can save any webpage to their Reading List.
2. Users can view saved webpages from the browser menu.
3. Users can remove saved webpages.
4. Reading List should synchronize across devices.
5. The feature should be fast and easy to use.

## Success Metrics

25% of users should use Reading List every week.

## Rollout Plan

Launch to all users after development and testing.
